public_reach.rationale: Clearly reachable and mixed, the anchor for this score. Iridium Communications Inc. (Nasdaq: IRDM) directly commercialized the Iridium PNT ASIC on 2026-07-14, its own press release stating the chip delivers cryptographically secure timing and location data through the Iridium satellite network specifically to protect devices against jamming and spoofing, with demand already reported from more than 150 organizations worldwide. That is a listed issuer monetizing exactly this occurrence today, not a story about it. Held at 60 rather than higher because the two other named names in the candidate's own proposed chain are weaker on reach: Xona Space Systems, building the rival Pulsar LEO PNT constellation, is confirmed privately held and venture-backed (a $92M Series B led by Craft Ventures, reported 2025-06-27); and Thales, which carries a PNT solutions unit, is itself a listed diversified defense group (Euronext Paris) but this run found no source breaking out PNT as a separately reported or sized business line within it, so its specific PNT exposure cannot be scored as cleanly reachable, only as embedded inside a much larger story.

That combination, proprietary infrastructure plus qualification-driven adoption across safety-critical sectors, argues for a score at or above 70. Not scored higher because this run found no disclosed revenue or margin figure specific to the PNT ASIC line itself (Iridium's press materials report adoption interest, not yet a broken-out financial contribution), so the leg is scored on demonstrated structural capture potential rather than a confirmed realized margin.
